title: moderation.completed
description: Consumed from stapel-moderation. Carries the verdict for one moderation target; listings applies it when the target is a listing (flips moderation_status and moves the lifecycle: publish on approval, REJECTED before publication, BLOCKED for a takedown of a live listing). Contract owned by the emitter — the shape below is what listings relies on. TARGET-GENERIC: the emitter is a queue over listings, reviews, profiles and chat messages, so it addresses its targets as {target_type, target_key}; `listing_id` is the pre-0.4 form, still accepted (the emitter may send either) and resolved as target_type="listing". Additional emitter-owned fields (case_id, source, decided_at, evidence bookkeeping) are accepted and ignored — this consumer must not reject a payload because the producer's contract grew.

case_id.description: Moderation case the verdict closes (emitter's id; not stored here).

target_type.description: Kind of moderated target, e.g. "listing". Verdicts for other target types are ignored by this module. Matched against STAPEL_LISTINGS['MODERATION_TARGET_TYPE'].

target_key.description: Opaque key of the target within target_type — the listing's primary key when target_type is "listing".

listing_id.description: Pre-0.4 alias for target_key with an implied target_type of "listing". Accepted for backward compatibility; new emitters send target_type/target_key.

decision.description: approved — no violation (publishes a PENDING listing, reinstates a BLOCKED one); rejected — violation (REJECTED before publication, BLOCKED takedown when live); needs_review — the automation abstained; dismissed — the report needed no action, the target is untouched.

reason_code.description: Key from the emitter's open reason registry. Recorded in moderation_note when no note is given.

note.description: Short statement of reasons, stored in moderation_note.
